title: NOAA NCCOS Lake Erie HAB Forecast

title: Heidelberg University NCWQR monitoring program
use: Public Great Lakes surface-water monitoring and data-portal context.

title: USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer
use: Agricultural landscape context; not farm-level management or export attribution.

use: Conservation and soil-management control context; effectiveness is site-dependent.

title: Ohio H2Ohio program

title: Ohio EPA NPDES program

title: USFWS National Wetlands Inventory
use: Wetland inventory and broad retention/transformation interface; no uniform removal rate.

title: Great Lakes Water Quality Agreement Annex 4
use: Binational nutrient-reduction target and adaptive-management context.

title: NOAA climate data and projections
use: External qualitative scenario driver for precipitation, temperature, and hydrologic variability.
